name: Sea Lotus APT organisation latest attack sample analysis
description: Sea Lotus ( OceanLotus ), also known as APT32 or APT-C-00 , is a long-term area of attacking China and other East Asian countries (regions) government, research institutions, shipping companies and other APT organization. Recently, Tencent Yumi threat intelligence center captured a sample of the organization’s latest attack. In this attack, the organization used CVE-2017-11882 vulnerabilities and combined with white signature utilization procedures to maximize the hidden behind their own Trojan. The backdoor Trojan will be stationed on the user's computer and will opportunistically steal confidential information or conduct a second-stage attack based on cloud control instructions.
